dated: CGI 2013 mis à jour LF 2022; Ordonnance 2024-59 (LF 2025)

entries.name: Droit de mutation immobilière à titre onéreux
entries.doc: art. 466: "Les adjudications, ventes, reventes, rétrocessions ... et tous autres actes civils et judiciaires translatifs de propriété ou d'usufruit de biens immeubles à titre onéreux sont assujettis à un droit de 3%." The LF 2025 (art. 30) amends art. 377 and 481 and repeals art. 469 and 482 only; LF 2023 and LF 2024 are not held: grade B.
notes: CGI art. 466: 3 % (edition updated to LF 2022; LF 2023-2024 not held)

entries.name: Impôt sur le revenu des valeurs mobilières, dividends (10 %, final)
entries.statute: CGI 2013 updated to LF 2022, art. 69, 74 (Ordonnance 2024-59, LF 2025, checked: art. 69-111 not amended; LF 2023 and LF 2024 not held)
entries.doc: art. 74: 10 % on dividends (7 % from companies listed on a CREPMF-approved exchange), 7 % on gains on shares, 6 % on bonds, 5 % on gains on bonds, 15 % on other products; the levies are final.

entries.name: Droits de mutation à titre gratuit (successions, donations)
entries.statute: CGI art. 459 (tariff by share and degree), art. 456 (gifts on the same tariff)
entries.doc: art. 459: "Les droits de mutation par décès sont fixés, pour la part nette recueillie par chaque ayant droit, après partage de l'héritage, selon le tarif du tableau ci-après": fractions 1-1 000 000, -2 000 000, -5 000 000, -10 000 000, above 10 000 000 F: first degree, direct line and spouses 0/1/2/3/4 %; brothers and sisters 2/3/4/5/6 %; uncles, aunts, nephews, nieces 4/5/6/7/8 %; great-uncles, cousins 5/7/7/8/9 %; beyond the fourth degree and non-relatives 15/16/17/18/19 % (pdftotext -layout). art. 456: "Les droits d'enregistrement des donations entre vifs sont perçus aux mêmes tarifs que ceux prévus à l'article 459". Edition updated to LF 2022; LF 2025 art. 30 does not touch these articles; LF 2023-2024 not held: grade B.
notes: CGI art. 459: grandchildren taken in the direct-line class; art. 457 25 % reduction for marriage-contract gifts and art. 460 provision not applied

entries.name: Stamp duty
entries.statute: Code général des impôts (loi n° 2012-37 du 20 juin 2012), DGI edition 'CGI 2013 MAJ LF 2022' + Ordonnance n° 2024-59 (LF 2025)
entries.why: triage minor: droit de timbre in the francophone codes = fixed stamps per sheet / instrument (dimension, receipts, passports, vehicle papers): no household base in the model; transfers of immovables are carried by the P5 registration (mutation) duties where modelled. listed by the registry (confirmed in reachable text); charging provision not read/modelled in this pass

entries.name: Taxe professionnelle (formerly patente: 1 per mille of turnover with floor and caps + 10 % of rental value)
entries.statute: CGI 2013 mis à jour LF 2022, art. 174-176 (LF 2025, ordonnance 2024-59, amends only art. 173; LF 2023-2024 not held)
entries.doc: art. 175: fixed duty 1 per mille of the previous year's turnover, at least 150 000 F, capped at 3 M (turnover up to 10 bn), 7 M (10-30 bn), 15 M (30-50 bn), 30 M (above); art. 176: proportional duty 10 % of the rental value of the premises, rented or free, at least a quarter of the fixed duty.
unsupported: specific rates 1,5 % / 3 % of rental value under art. 169 sexies (art. 176), transport-sector taxe professionnelle (section III), new-business and young-entrepreneur exemptions (art. 173)

entries.name: Zakat (as a tax)
entries.why: NE: the general tax code held (CGI-2013-MAJ-LF2022.txt, 1154k chars) has no zakat provision (full-text search 'zakat/zakât/zakah')

entries.name: Net wealth tax
entries.why: NE: the general tax code held (CGI-2013-MAJ-LF2022.txt) has no charging provision on net wealth (full-text search 'impôt sur la fortune / le patrimoine', 'patrimoine net'); edition as held, later finance laws not all checked

entries.name: Vignette (annual motor-vehicle tax by fiscal horsepower)
entries.statute: CGI 2013 mis à jour LF 2022 art. 207-212 (LF 2025 does not amend them; LF 2023-2024 not held)
unsupported: exemptions (art. 211: below 1 CV, public bodies, invalids, stock for sale)

entries.name: Impôt sur le revenu des créances, interest on deposit and current accounts (10 %)
entries.statute: CGI 2013/LF 2022 art. 79-80 (LF 2025 checked; LF 2023-2024 not held)
entries.doc: art. 80: 20 %, but 10 % for interest on deposit and current accounts with banks and similar bodies, exchange agents, brokers, treasurers and agricultural credit funds (the household's interest is taken to be bank interest).

entries.name: IRVM on gains on shares (7 %, final)
Impôt sur les plus-values de cessions immobilières (5 %)
entries.doc: art. 110: gain = sale price less the acquisition price, the latter increased by a flat 10 % for acquisition costs and by works; art. 111: 5 %.
unsupported: flat 10 % uplift of the acquisition price for acquisition costs (art. 110): the household's stated costs are used instead
works at cost or a flat 10 %

entries.name: Taxe d'apprentissage (3 %)
entries.statute: CGI Livre I art. 129-130 as replaced by Ordonnance n° 2024-59 (LF 2025) art. 15, from 1 January 2025
entries.doc: art. 129 (new): base = all remuneration paid in money plus benefits in kind, less listed deductions (new firms' first year, training costs, apprentices, new permanent contracts...); art. 130 (new): 3 % (the former 5 % for non-national workers and the reductions of art. 131-136 are repealed).
unsupported: deductions of art. 129 (new firms, apprentices, net pay of new contracts in the year)

entries.name: Impôt sur les revenus des baux d'habitation (12 % of annual rental value; main residence exempt)
entries.statute: CGI Livre I art. 146-148, 159 as amended by Ordonnance n° 2024-59 (LF 2025) art. 16
entries.doc: art. 147: base = rental value of buildings let as dwellings; art. 148 (new): 12 % of the annual rental value, 6 % for free and secondary dwellings; art. 159 6° (new): the main residence is exempt. The household's other buildings are taken as let dwellings.
unsupported: 6 % for dwellings occupied free and secondary homes
impôt sur les revenus des baux professionnels 12 % (art. 151)

entries.name: CNSS employer contributions incl. ANPE (family 8,4 %, work accidents 1,75 %, pensions 6,25 %, ANPE 1 %; ceiling 500 000 F a month)
entries.statute: CNSS Niger 'Guide de l'employeur' (December 2019; décret n° 2005-64/MFP/T art. 31-32; held ne/law/w5) and CLEISS 'Les cotisations au Niger' (1 Jan 2024, ANPE 1 %)
entries.doc: Guide 2019: 'Le plafond annuel ... est de 6.000.000 F.CFA'; 8,4 % family, 1,75 % work accidents, pensions 6,25 % employer / 5,25 % worker, ANPE 0,5 %. CLEISS 2024: same branch rates, 'Agence Nationale pour la Promotion de l'Emploi (ANPE) 1 %', ceiling 500 000 FCFA a month, total employer 17,40 %.
unsupported: ANPE rate: 0,5 % in the 2019 guide, 1 % in the 2024 CLEISS table (later source used)
